All pass: clean NOVEL audit (no learned-policy application of UCM/minimal-intervention loss reweighting found), attacks evidenced init-state robustness + data efficiency with a concrete overfit-to-nuisance-directions causal story, ships a cheap pre-registered diagnostic (does the learned subspace concentrate on task-relevant dims) plus a uniform-vs-reweighted ablation, applies to flow-matching (SmolVLA/pi0) and L1 (OFT) losses with <1M params and zero inference cost — the writeup must still cite classical minimal-intervention/variance-weighted LfD (Calinon-style) as adjacent prior art the audit did not surface.

B: the premise (sparse, independent per-timestep errors while parity survives) is unvalidated and implausible — parity coefficients are emitted by the same corrupted forward pass as the systematic values, so no plausible effect size on perturbation robustness. C: channel coding requires noise injected independently AFTER encoding; here corruption enters upstream in perception, so data and parity symbols fail together and syndrome decoding projects onto some codeword, not the true actions — a systematic perceptual error yields a confidently wrong-but-consistent chunk, and any residual gain is indistinguishable from generic auxiliary-head/ensemble regularization. E: adds parameters and a decoder while the claimed robustness/SR/latency gains collapse under correlated errors — fails the >=3-dimensions clause. F: reviewers kill the channel analogy on page one (there is no independent noise channel between head output and dispatch).

All pass: audit-verified NOVEL (no VLA/manipulation evidential per-camera fusion found in 4 searches), directly attacks the worst measured LIBERO-Plus factor (camera viewpoint) with a falsifiable per-view evidence-gating story, inserts at the encoder/fusion boundary shared by SmolVLA/pi0/OFT-class multi-cam VLAs, ~100s of K params trainable in hours on 1xA100 improving robustness+SR+generalization, and a first-in-VLA mechanism on the top documented failure mode is a credible RA-L/CoRL contribution.

debates.attack_summary: The sharpest attack is a mechanism-to-bottleneck mismatch plus a demo-variance/causal-irrelevance conflation. LIBERO-Plus robustness collapse is perception-driven (frozen features shift under viewpoint/init-state perturbation), yet reweighting which action dimensions the flow-matching loss penalizes cannot change the state-to-action map's ability to handle a novel init state — the robustness claim routes only through an optimistic "less overfitting improves OOD generalization" argument. Worse, the "uncontrolled" subspace is the null space of a learned open-loop chunk-to-goal map; that null space need not be safe in closed-loop contact-rich execution, so relaxing those dims can produce noisier/invalid actions and hurt success. Secondary hits: it may reduce to trivial per-dim inverse-variance loss weighting (SmolVLA already normalizes actions), and it shares its core primitive with C29.
debates.verdict_reasoning: The critic scores real damage on the headline robustness rationale and on the demo-variance-equals-irrelevance assumption, but each major attack has a partial rebuttal (the data-efficiency/generalization framing survives independently, and capacity-control regularization is a legitimate OOD lever), so the critic does not clearly dominate. Novelty is audit-confirmed and the mechanism is frozen-backbone compatible with near-zero inference cost. Decisively for R1, the premise is gated by an explicit cheap diagnostic that would expose a non-concentrating subspace before any GPU-month run, so a false survivor is cheap to catch downstream — the concerns become bars to clear in later rounds, not grounds for a first-round kill.

debates.attack_summary: The relevance projector's proposed training signal does not exist: demos are success-only, so "predict task-completion from partial chunk perturbations" requires generating perturbed counterfactual sim rollouts per (state, chunk) — expensive, sim-oracle-dependent, and a hidden cost the integration path omits. Avoid that and you fall back to per-timestep demo inverse-variance weighting, which is classical LfD (Calinon minimal-intervention control, ProMP/GMR covariance-weighted tracking) and learned anisotropic loss weighting is heteroscedastic regression (Kendall & Gal 2017) — the audit's NOVEL verdict is an artifact of searching only "uncontrolled manifold" vocabulary. Mechanistically, chunks execute open-loop: relaxing loss in "uncontrolled" directions licenses drift off the demo manifold (compounding covariate shift), plausibly worsening the long-horizon bottleneck it claims to fix, and LIBERO's ~7-dim EE-delta action space lacks the DOF redundancy the UCM premise needs.
debates.verdict_reasoning: Both horns of the central dilemma are fatal: the novel version of the projector is infeasible without counterfactual rollout supervision, and the feasible version collapses into 15-year-old variance-weighted imitation plus standard heteroscedastic loss learning — so the delta over nearest prior art evaporates exactly when the method becomes runnable. On top of that, the causal chain to LIBERO-Plus is weak (its dominant failures are perception-side, untouched by an action-loss reweighting) and the method is a full action-expert retrain per condition per seed, not the cheap plug-in the project wants. A GPU-month on this would likely yield a noisy few-point delta with a reviewer-obvious prior-art rebuttal.

debates.attack_summary: The minimal-intervention principle produces robustness through closed-loop feedback that exploits redundancy at execution time; C4 only reshapes the training loss of an open-loop chunk generator, leaving zero execution-time mechanism to absorb LIBERO-Plus viewpoint/init-state perturbations — so the robustness and generalization claims (2 of its 3 dimensions) rest on an analogy that does not transfer. What remains is anisotropic per-dimension loss weighting, whose effect a standard heteroscedastic/learned-variance baseline largely replicates for free (demo dims that vary freely get high variance and are auto-downweighted), and flow matching already allocates probability mass to free-varying directions rather than 'wasting capacity nailing' them, undercutting the stated capacity-waste mechanism. Additionally, labeling task-relevance honestly requires counterfactual perturbation rollouts in sim (a heavy pipeline), or it collapses to variance-correlation from demos — the exact baseline; and every ablation requires a full action-expert retrain, so it is a training recipe, not the plug-in module the project targets.
debates.verdict_reasoning: Even granting the clean novelty field (audit: NOVEL, 0.75), the credible effect is a modest data-efficiency/fitting gain on one dimension, not a plausible move on three: the causal chain to robustness/generalization is speculative and the nearest baseline likely captures most of the gain, making the headline a subtle loss-weighting ablation. A training-loss tweak with no inference-time component and likely single-digit gains on one axis is workshop-scale, not CoRL/RA-L/TMLR-scale, and validating it costs full policy retrains per ablation — exactly the false-survivor GPU-month risk this round exists to prevent.

debates.attack_summary: LIBERO-Plus viewpoint shift is a systematic domain shift, not sensor corruption: the shifted agentview still carries all task information, so down-weighting it discards signal rather than recovering it, and the gain is hard-capped by wrist-cam-only sufficiency, which is doubtful for scene-level object localization (and init-state, the -88pt second-worst factor, is untouched). Worse, the method requires a synthetic single-camera corruption generator at training time, and that same generator applied as plain augmentation to the action expert is the mandatory fair baseline that uses a strict superset of the gate's training signal and, per LIBERO-Plus's own analyses, already recovers much of the drop. Finally, TMC's Dirichlet/Dempster-Shafer fusion is defined over class evidences; with a continuous flow-matching token interface and no classes it degenerates into a learned scalar gate, evaporating the evidential novelty into generic gated fusion over n=2 cameras.
debates.verdict_reasoning: The critic's two structural attacks hit premise and delta, not execution: expected headroom is capped because the mechanism treats domain shift as sensor failure with a likely-insufficient fallback view, and the augmentation baseline built from the method's own required corruption machinery probably dominates it. Verified novelty (audit NOVEL, 0.65) and low cost cannot rescue a mechanism whose best case is a small gain on one perturbation axis that a simpler baseline likely matches; under the kill-bias criterion this is a clear kill.

debates.attack_summary: The mechanism attacks the wrong layer for the headline failure mode: a LIBERO-Plus camera-viewpoint shift produces features that are OOD-but-still-informative, and with only two largely complementary (not redundant) views there is no good trust setting — keeping the shifted agentview feeds the frozen expert features it cannot decode, while down-weighting it removes the policy's only source of global scene geometry (the wrist cam is uninformative pre-grasp), so gating cannot recover the -91pt factor it is sold on. The evaluation is intrinsically confounded: the gate must be trained with synthetic single-camera corruption, which is itself a robustness intervention overlapping LIBERO-Plus's programmatic perturbations, so the fair baseline (SmolVLA finetuned with identical corruption/camera-dropout augmentation, no gate) plausibly captures most of the gain, leaving a gate-specific delta within 3-seed noise. Technically, TMC's Dirichlet evidence is defined over a classification simplex that does not exist in a continuous flow-matching pipeline, and Dempster-Shafer combination of exactly 2 sources degenerates to normalized product weighting — i.e., a learned scalar camera gate — while being at its most brittle (Zadeh's conflict pathology) in precisely the high-conflict regime targeted.
debates.verdict_reasoning: Killed: novelty is a thin straight transfer of TMC (audit's own confidence only 0.65) whose apparatus collapses to a two-stream learned gate, and the core scientific premise — that an intact view can substitute for a corrupted one — is unvalidated and likely false for LIBERO's complementary agentview/wrist setup, with no cheap diagnostic proposed. Even the best-case win is capped to the viewpoint slice (does nothing for init-state, the second -88pt factor) and must survive an augmentation-only baseline that the design cannot be disentangled from; the expected residual effect does not justify a GPU-month.

debates.attack_summary: C7's three claimed dimensions (robustness, success rate, generalization) are one measurement counted three times — LIBERO-Plus perturbed success — so it is a single-factor patch on one benchmark axis, not a mechanism moving >=3 dimensions. Its ceiling is structurally capped: LIBERO-Plus viewpoint shift produces a valid-but-displaced agentview, not a corrupted one, and down-weighting it leaves a wrist-cam-only policy that lacks the scene-level information (object/target localization pre-grasp) needed to succeed, so discounting the 'bad' view cannot restore what the policy actually needs. With only N=2 cameras the Dempster-Shafer/Dirichlet machinery reduces to a learned scalar blend, and the training recipe (synthetic viewpoint jitter/brightness/occlusion) directly mimics the test perturbations — so trivial baselines (corruption-augmented head training, camera dropout, a 2-way softmax gate) plausibly capture most of the gain, leaving the evidential contribution unattributable.
debates.verdict_reasoning: Even granting the audit's NOVEL verdict, the audit itself calls this a domain transfer of TMC (2022) — technique transfer plus one perturbation factor on one sim benchmark family is workshop-tier positioning for CoRL/RA-L unless gains are both large and broad, and the mechanism's information-loss ceiling makes large gains implausible while the augmentation-confound makes attribution to the evidential rule doubtful. The best realistic outcome is an ablation-table entry on LIBERO-Plus camera factors, which does not justify a GPU-month against competing survivors that credibly touch long-horizon, latency, or data-efficiency as well.
